children: France marketing and communication expert's H1 gross profit grew 26.7% yr/yr
Adjusted EPS for H1 rose 30.7% yr/yr, adjusted net income up 29.5%
Company revised 2026 gross profit guidance downward, resumed share buyback, continued Sogec restructuring
HighCo revises 2026 gross profit guidance to more than €77 mln, down from over €78 mln
Company now expects 2026 reported gross profit growth of more than 15%, down from over 17%
HighCo raises 2026 adjusted operating margin outlook to close to 13%, from more than 12%
Company expects adjusted operating margin above 15% as of 2027
FRENCH MARKET MOMENTUM - Co said H1 growth was driven by strong business activity in France, notably in Retail Activation
ACQUISITION IMPACT - Integration of Sogec and Budgetbox contributed to reported gross profit growth
RESTRUCTURING COSTS - Sogec restructuring led to €5.54 mln in expenses, impacting reported operating income
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advertising & marketing peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for High Co SA is €4.50, about 26.4% above its September 8 closing price of €3.56
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
